env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

! logos build -buildvcs=false -o bump.exe ./bump
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos build -buildvcs=false -o head.exe ./head
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos build -buildvcs=false -o indexed.exe ./indexed
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'

logos build -buildvcs=false -o nilcase.exe ./nilcase
exec ./nilcase.exe
stderr '^ok$'

logos build -buildvcs=false -o idxcase.exe ./idxcase
exec ./idxcase.exe
stderr '^ok$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/receiver

go 1.27

-- lib/set.lgo --
package lib

type Set struct {
	Items []int
	Tag   string
}

func (s Set) Bump() { s.Items[0]++ }
func (s Set) Head() []int { return s.Items }
func (s Set) Grow() int {
	s.Items = append(s.Items, 0)
	return len(s.Items)
}

-- bump/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/receiver/lib"

const s = lib.Set{Items: []int{1}}

func main() { s.Bump() }

-- head/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/receiver/lib"

const s = lib.Set{Items: []int{1}}

func main() {
	h := s.Head()
	h[0] = 9
}

-- indexed/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/receiver/lib"

type Rec struct {
	Set lib.Set
}

const records = []Rec{{}, {Set: lib.Set{Items: []int{1}}}}

func bump(i int) { records[i].Set.Bump() }
func main() { bump(1) }

-- nilcase/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/receiver/lib"

const s = lib.Set{Tag: "t"}

func main() {
	if s.Grow() != 1 {
		println("bad")
		return
	}
	println("ok")
}

-- idxcase/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/receiver/lib"

type Rec struct {
	Set lib.Set
}

const records = []Rec{{}, {Set: lib.Set{}}}

func probe(i int) int { return records[i].Set.Grow() }
func main() {
	if probe(0) != 1 || probe(1) != 1 {
		println("bad")
		return
	}
	println("ok")
}
